title: bug(ci): SDK tests not run in PR CI; nightly broken by incorrect mock in session.test.ts

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a detailed, actionable report of failing unit tests in packages/sdk/src/session.test.ts and missing test coverage for @google/gemini-cli-sdk in .github/workflows/ci.yml. It includes clear error messages, root cause analysis, failing test cases, and precise suggested fixes.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The issue requires localized updates: updating mock objects in packages/sdk/src/session.test.ts to match the AgentLoopContext interface properties, and adding @google/gemini-cli-sdk to the test matrix in .github/workflows/ci.yml. The root cause and fix are straightforward with low complexity.

summary.problem: Nightly release tests in packages/sdk/src/session.test.ts fail due to an invalid mock object, and @google/gemini-cli-sdk tests are not executed during PR CI runs.
summary.root_cause: GeminiCliSession accesses toolRegistry, messageBus, and geminiClient as properties on AgentLoopContext (casted from this.config), but mockConfig in session.test.ts provided them as methods (getGeminiClient(), getToolRegistry(), getMessageBus()). Furthermore, .github/workflows/ci.yml omits --workspace "@google/gemini-cli-sdk" from the others test shard, so SDK tests are skipped on PRs.
summary.context: AgentLoopContext interface in @google/gemini-cli-core exposes geminiClient, toolRegistry, and messageBus as direct properties rather than getter functions.

steps: In .github/workflows/ci.yml, add --workspace "@google/gemini-cli-sdk" to the others test shard commands.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: All tests in packages/sdk/src/session.test.ts pass, and @google/gemini-cli-sdk unit tests run as part of the others shard in PR CI checks.
verification_steps: In packages/sdk/src/session.test.ts, update mockConfig to include geminiClient, toolRegistry, and messageBus as properties matching AgentLoopContext.
Run `npm run test:ci --workspace "@google/gemini-cli-sdk"` to verify all tests in session.test.ts pass.
